errors.text_span: 在三种关系抽取任务（准确率、召回率和 F1 值）上
errors.evidence: Precision (准确率), recall (召回率), and F1 are performance metrics for the task, not tasks themselves. The task is relation extraction.
The y-axis tick marks are at 0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100, so the interval is 20, not 10.
